name: Store Rules
author: WC Studio

sections.description:
Store Rules is a feature-rich WooCommerce plugin designed to give store owners complete control over purchase conditions. It allows you to set custom purchase rules based on various conditions, such as categories, user roles, schedules, product metadata, and cart conditions.

With Store Rules, you can create dynamic pricing strategies, restrict purchases under specific conditions, and offer exclusive deals to targeted customer segments.

Key Features:

🎯 Rule Application Hierarchy

Store Rules apply purchase conditions in the following priority order:
1️⃣ General → 2️⃣ Category → 3️⃣ Role → 4️⃣ Schedule → 5️⃣ Product Meta

Each level can override the previous one, allowing for fine-tuned purchase control.

🛠 Modules Overview

1️⃣ General Rules (Global Store-Wide Rules)

✔ Applies store-wide purchase conditions as the base rule.
✔ Can be overridden by more specific rule types.

2️⃣ Category-Based Rules

✔ Set custom purchase rules per product category.
✔ Apply discounts, restrictions, or exclusive offers for selected categories.
✔ Perfect for seasonal sales, VIP pricing, or bulk category-based purchases rules.

3️⃣ Role-Based Rules

✔ Assign purchase conditions based on user roles (Admin, Customer, Wholesale, Guest).
✔ Differentiate pricing strategies for retail, wholesale, and VIP customers.
✔ Ideal for B2B WooCommerce stores.

4️⃣ Schedule-Based Rules

✔ Automate purchase rules for time-sensitive promotions (flash sales, holiday offers, etc.).
✔ Set start and end dates for limited-time discounts.
✔ Enable or disable products at scheduled times.

5️⃣ Product Meta-Based Rules

✔ Apply purchase conditions based on SKUs, product tags, or metadata.
✔ Target specific products using WooCommerce custom fields.
✔ Great for exclusive promotions, restricted items, or custom product pricing.

6️⃣ Cart-Based Rules (Independent Feature)

✔ Works separately from other modules.
✔ Apply purchase restrictions based on cart value, quantity, or total items.
✔ Useful for bulk purchase limits, free shipping thresholds, and cart-based pricing rules.

7️⃣ Area-Based Rules (Checkout-Based Feature)

✔ Implement location-based purchase rules.
✔ Restrict or allow purchases based on shipping zones, billing addresses, or country-based conditions.
✔ Perfect for geo-restricted pricing and international selling policies.

Why Choose Store Rules?

✅ Comprehensive Purchase Rule Management
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration
✅ Time-Based & Location-Based Rules
✅ Flexible Customization for Any Store
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install

    • Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/store-rules directory.
    • Or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Go to the Plugins menu and activate Store Rules.

  3. Configure Settings

    • Navigate to Store Rules and configure the purchase conditions as per your store’s needs.
sections.faq:
❓ How does the priority system work?

The plugin applies rules in this order: General → Category → Role → Schedule → Product Meta.
Each level overrides the previous one, ensuring that more specific rules take precedence over general ones.

❓ Can I create multiple purchase rules at the same time?

Yes, you can define multiple rules across different modules and control their execution priority.

❓ Does Store Rules support scheduled promotions?

Yes! You can set start and end times for purchase rules, making it perfect for seasonal sales, flash deals, and timed discounts.

❓ Is Store Rules compatible with other WooCommerce plugins?

Yes, Store Rules is built for seamless integration with WooCommerce and should work with most third-party plugins.
